llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must run animation-critical computation in UI-runtime worklets (for example `useDerivedValue`/worklet functions) over shared values.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: useAnimatedReaction computes percent and newThreshold on the UI thread as a worklet reaction over shared values (progress, threshold).

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must dispatch start/stop or control worklet functions from React runtime using `scheduleOnUI(...)` from `react-native-worklets` and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnUI`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: No scheduleOnUI() from react-native-worklets is used anywhere. The package.json has no react-native-worklets dependency. Start/stop is triggered directly from a React onPress handler with no UI-dispatch wrapper.
evidence: startAnimation called directly via onPress with no scheduleOnUI wrapper

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must bridge UI-runtime checkpoint updates back to React via `scheduleOnRN(...)` from `react-native-worklets` and MUST NOT use deprecated `runOnJS`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Bridge back to React runtime uses deprecated runOnJS (imported from react-native-reanimated), not scheduleOnRN from react-native-worklets.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must gate `scheduleOnRN(...)` behind explicit bucket/checkpoint logic in a UI worklet reaction (for example `useAnimatedReaction`) instead of calling it every frame.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: scheduleOnRN/runOnJS is called only when newThreshold !== threshold.value inside useAnimatedReaction, bounding updates to at most 5 discrete checkpoint transitions rather than every frame.
